purpose: Correct composition-confounded exposure claims and describe low-score probability transport without claiming mechanism identification.

exposure_levels.E2: exact (question_key, answer_key) response seen in train
exposure_levels.E1: question_key seen but exact response unseen

common_support.primary_comparison: E1 versus E2 because E0 is reported only if observed
common_support.weights: pooled row-frequency weights normalized over strata containing both groups
common_support.bootstrap: question-cluster exponential multiplier bootstrap with fixed common-support strata and fixed pooled weights

nested_transport.interpretation: descriptive existence analysis only; cannot distinguish support shortage from DPO estimand mismatch

decision_rules.response_identification_data: E1-minus-E2 standardized MAE >=0.05 with 95% CI above zero in at least two seeds
decision_rules.low_boundary_identification_data: all three seeds have positive removed high-score mass, MCR>=0.50, GLE<=0.35 on all_low
decision_rules.otherwise: write thesis and authorize no new method on current data
